correctness.rationale: On two worlds, each single-variable modal operation has four input valuations and 2-bit output, so exactly 256 possible tables. Saturation from constants/identity under ∧∨□◇ and optionally complement is exactly the positive or full grammar by induction both directions; it reaches a true finite fixed point independent of formula depth. Monotone full terms are detected by the four covers in P(W). Independently reimplemented 8-bit complete saturation for all 16 labeled relations; bad masks exactly [7,14,15], representatives 7 with (|P|,|T|,|M|,|M\P|)=(10,64,18,8) and 15 with (5,16,6,1), all other tables agree with frozen table. χ(p)=◇p∧(□p∨¬p) is monotone, and positive simulation on Z={(0,0),(0,1),(1,0)} rules out positive representation for bad types. Both singleton frames have equality. Structural/computational completeness is finite algebra, not bounded syntactic depth.
